dct_description_sm: Settlements and residential areas: named cities, towns, villages, suburbs, and residential land (`place=*` and `landuse=residential`). Useful for demographic context, settlement-level targeting, and population analysis. Coverage reflects where volunteer mappers have been active. Urban areas are usually well represented, remote areas may be sparse. Cross-check critical decisions with local field knowledge. - Source: [OpenStreetMap](https://www.openstreetmap.org), a free, collaborative world map - Tags: [place](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:place), [landuse](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:landuse) - Part of the [country exports on HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hot/) by [HOT](https://www.hotosm.org/)
